title: Modified 7-Day Split
author: Ben S.
desc: To achieve aesthetics and strength simultaneously.

ex.note: Work to a heavy single.
Strict Curl.
Partial DB Triceps Kickback
Drop Set

EZ Bar French Press

Standing.  Utilize stretch at the bottom.

Bicep Opener Super Set

Reps Palms up + Reps Hammer.

Bodyweight.

Upgrade into front lever progressions over time.

Back Extension Ab Crunch

Small pulse reps first, then deeper pulse reps, then progress to full deep reps and iso holds.

Back Extension Side Crunch

1. Shallow Reps
2. Deeper Reps
3. Full Depth Reps (AMRAP)

Decline Oblique Twist

AMRAP with weight.
Hip Flexor Work

OR do...
- Singles 95-99% of 1RM (AMSAP)

*Top Set and Claim Territory*

Note: 
If low rep top set, do high rep for RPE 8, and vice versa
Top Set and Claim Terrritory
Explosive Bench Press w/ band
45 degree elbows.  Incline set slightly above flat bench.
Cables.  Hybrid between fly and press
Until Failure.
Cables.  3 x 5 + Rotational Mobility Super Set
Less range of motion with heavy reps.
More range of motion with lighter reps.
Pull shoulder blades into back pockets.  Arms stay straight.

Single Arm T-Bar Row

Partial reps if heavy.
Controlled full ROM with lighter reps.
Focus on pulling through shoulder blades and bringing elbows back.  Limit bicep and forearm use.
Cable machine.  Use 2 cables, each with a handle.  Perform single arm lat pulldowns with both cables simultaneously.  Focus on different angles and different ROMs.  These should not be super heavy.

Rotating Cable Crossover Reverse Fly. 

Engage biceps to deactivate triceps.  Go light to get more reps.  Work through different angles and ROMs.  Should feel this in your rear delts!

2 Dumbbells, one per hand!

Focus on deep pulse stretches.  Partial reps are fine to engage the lats the entire time.
Set 1 - Top Set (Claim)

Set 1 - Top Set (Palms Forward)
Set 2-3 - Neutral Grip (Palms in)
EZ Behind Head Press (Pulse)
Exercise Ball Lateral Raise
DB Prone Trap Raise
Flat Shoulder Press
Machine Knee Extension
Heavy or light band or BW

OR do...
- Singles 95-99% of 1RM (AMSAP)
